lines.rom: jaya dhanvantari deva jaya dhanvantari ji deva jara roga se pirita jana jana sukha deva
tuma samudra se nikale amrta kalasa lie devasura ke samkata akara dura kie
ayurveda banaya jaga mem phailaya sada svastha rahane ka sadhana batalaya
bhuja cara ati sundara samkha sudha dhari ayurveda vanaspati se sobha bhari
tuma ko jo nita dhyave roga nahim ave asadhya roga bhi usaka niscaya mita jave
hatha jorakara prabhuji dasa khara tera vaidya samaja tumhare caranom ka ghera
dhanvantariji ki arati jo koi nara gave roga soka na ae sukha samrddhi pave
